# Run outcomes

How a solve ended (`RunResult.outcome`). Anything but `CONVERGED` comes with a failure bundle, and `RunResult.failure` explains it. How to read an explanation, and how to ask for one (`openflowsheet explain <code>`, the `explain` operation), is on [Messages](index.md).

<a id="ACTIVE_SET_CYCLING"></a>

## `ACTIVE_SET_CYCLING`: Active set cycling

**Kind:** Numerical failure: the solver did not find the solution; your flowsheet may be correct.

*No plain-language explanation is written yet; the summary is the technical one.*

- **Summary:** The solve ended ACTIVE_SET_CYCLING (homotopy/PTC/active-set stalls).

<a id="INITIALIZATION_FAILED"></a>

## `INITIALIZATION_FAILED`: The solve could not find a starting point

**Kind:** Numerical failure: the solver did not find the solution; your flowsheet may be correct.

- **Summary:** The solve of revision &lt;revision&gt; could not find a starting point at unit &lt;unit&gt;.
- **Context:** The solve of revision &lt;revision&gt; stopped before its first iteration: unit &lt;unit&gt; (&lt;unit_model&gt;) could not compute its outlets from the starting values.
- **Why:** Before iterating, OpenFlowsheet computes every unit once, in flow order, from the feeds and the specifications. One unit could not, so there was no starting point.
- **Do:** Check the specifications of the unit named; if they are right, supply an initial guess for the recycle streams.
- **Parameters:** `unit` (unit, optional)

Example:

```text
The solve could not find a starting point at unit 'T'.
  Why:     Before iterating, OpenFlowsheet computes every unit once, in flow order, from the feeds and the specifications. One unit could not, so there was no starting point.
  Do:      Check the specifications of the unit named; if they are right, supply an initial guess for the recycle streams.
  Kind:    Numerical failure: the solver did not find the solution; your flowsheet may be correct.
  Code:    INITIALIZATION_FAILED (openflowsheet explain INITIALIZATION_FAILED)
  Docs:    https://computational-chemical-engineering.github.io/openflowsheet/messages/outcomes/#INITIALIZATION_FAILED
```
